summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for TLV9002IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8, opamp-dual): evaluated 9 same-category OPNs, surfacing 0 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 6 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 2 Level 3 Layout Change options. Verify pinout, thermal margin, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Verify device class (opamp) and output stage (push-pull) — never substitute an uncompensated open-collector comparator for a push-pull op-amp without circuit redesign.
Confirm supply rail span (1.8–5.5 V rec, 7 V abs max) and exact SOIC-8 pinout (1=OUT_A, 2=IN_NEG_A, 3=IN_POS_A, 4=VEE, 5=IN_POS_B, 6=IN_NEG_B, 7=OUT_B, 8=VCC).
Verify input common-mode headroom (RR-In), output swing (RR-Out), and Vos (1.6 mV max) against signal chain budget.
Check closed-loop bandwidth (GBWP / Acl), full-power slew rate (SR / 2π·Vpeak), and capacitive-load phase margin on the bench.
